title: Product marketing
slide_intent: Give readers a pause before the individual product descriptions. A brief visual cue helps them locate the new subject in the book.
strategic_value: Voltera can use a recurring dark divider to make transitions recognizable while the changing icon identifies messages about the product line.
demonstration: The page centers a small line icon above the white heading “Product marketing” on a charcoal field.
practical_value: Use this treatment when introducing the individual product descriptions. Reserve the detailed guidance for the pages after the divider.

content_islands.name: Section icon
content_islands.spec: Center a white megaphone with cyan sound marks above the title. Give the outlined drawing a single colored detail.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Set “Product marketing” in white on one line below the icon. Keep the charcoal field open around both elements.
